reviews.text: I highly recommend Reflection Pools Arlington Texas.  We had the blue Smoothstone (pebble) surface installed and it looks great.  Before and after pics attached.  Sebastian was very knowledgeable about our options, pricing was very reasonable, work was on schedule and professional, and result is beautiful.  Give Sebastian a call if you need a pool resurface.
reviews.author: Mike Bahr

reviews.text: Sebastian (Reflection Pools) was refered to us by a by our pool service technician. We contacted him about a complete rehab on our pool and he was very eager to show up and bid and get a deposit. That was about it as far as eagerness. If I had reviewed when the job initially finished it would have been 4 stars but I waited and I'm glad I did. Not long after completion, the travertine deck began to sink in places and around the skimmer basket it began to wobble. I didn't panic because I was told by Sebastian this was normal and they'd take care of it (late in the summer of 23). The wife contacted him in December of 23 and I took over contacting him in February of 24. Since then we have had excuses of, we've been busy, it's been raining, etc. Moral of this story is cheapest isn't always the way to go. If he ever shows up to repair his work I will edit this review but I'm not holding my breath! Sidebar,  our pool still looks 100 times better than before but for near 30k it should not have these issues!
reviews.author: Gerald Casey

reviews.text: Sebastian was referred to us by our regular pool cleaning service. He was great at showing us what we could do. He helped us stay within our budget. And most of all he turned our run down pool into an amazing place for the family to gather and swim. They worked very hard and cleaned up everything when they were done. Sebastian also followed up several times to make sure we were happy and always answered any questions we had. I plan on using them again and would recommend them to everyone.
reviews.author: D Lipsey

reviews.text:
I have known Sebastian at Refection Pools for a couple of years now. He has not only filled in as a service tech occasionally, but also provided my clients great customer service on renovation of their pool with retile and replaster.

This said:
Being a Home Warranty tech is very hard work - always getting caught in the cross fires with the clients expectations and keeping the 'budget' as the warranty company would like them to do.

I would recommend Sebastian!
reviews.author: Shellie B

reviews.text: I had a good experience with Reflection pools.  They were assigned the work through my home warranty company.  Sebastian called me within minutes of filing the claim.  My pump motor was bad which he diagnosed quickly and was covered under my warranty.  They ordered the new motor and were back in a couple days as promised to install.  Sebastian explained everything thoroughly and phoned with status updates or promptly returned my calls.
reviews.author: John Reed

reviews.text: I had 2 good experiences with Sebastian and his crew.  Work was done on a timely manner with no issues.  Installed new pool pump and fixed backwash fittings for no extra charge.  I have called him on multiple times with questions and he has always answered/returned calls to check on my pool.  I would recommend Reflection Pools for any service.
reviews.author: Rodney Barthelemess

reviews.text: We've had a great experience with Reflection Pools with their services in rehabbing our pool. They were very thorough, professional and paid great attention to detail. They started the reno when they said they would and completed the project when they said they would. They have followed-up with us checking to make sure everything was to our satisfaction and will be continuing to follow-up over the next couple of weeks to ensure that all is well. I highly recommend them for your pool project.
reviews.author: Craig Root

reviews.text:
Outstanding service. This company is night and day from the other pool companies I’ve used. This is the third one in 2 years. The others gave me the run around, tried to sell me stuff I didn’t need, and did some shoddy work. One of them even told the home warranty company they changed my pump..although they had not and the problem was still there. The H/W company sent out Reflection pools after I had to make another claim. Sabastian came out, immediately knew what the issue was. Being a new pool owner, I had many pool questions, and he took the extra time to go over everything with me, without trying to sell me anything. He even called the H/W company and got them to waive the $75 fee because the original problem wasn't fixed.
He replaced the faulty pump and fixed the misrouted pipes and valves the first pool company had 'fixed'.  So I’ve found the only pool company I going to use from now on.
reviews.author: Robert I

data.summary: The reviews present a mixed but concerning picture. The business has longevity and a good BBB rating, but the Google reviews are polarized and low in volume for its age. Several 5-star reviews feel generic and focus on the same individual, while the critical review details significant, credible post-project failures. This pattern suggests potential review manipulation to offset genuine customer dissatisfaction.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews mention the same employee (Sebastian) in very similar, generic positive terms
Several 5-star reviews are from 6 years ago, creating a potential 'review gap'
Low total review count (49) for a 31-year-old business is suspicious
Strategic sample shows a polarized distribution (mostly 5-star and 1-star) with few mid-range reviews
authentic_signals: The 1-star review provides specific, credible details about project failures (sinking travertine, wobbly skimmer)
Some 5-star reviews mention specific project types (resurface, pump replacement) and reasonable timelines
BBB accreditation and A+ rating suggest formal complaint resolution processes
complaint_patterns: Post-completion quality issues (deck sinking, tile wobble)
Lack of responsiveness after initial eagerness
data.discrepancy_explanation: BBB shows A+ rating with 31 years in business, but Google shows a low 3.1-star average with only 49 reviews. This suggests either low review volume on Google or potential review suppression/manipulation. The BBB rating reflects complaint handling, not service quality.
